rows.reasoning: The only source is Marsh's No vote on SB 1828 (2021), an omnibus taxation bill covering unemployment insurance, property tax aid, sales tax exemptions, income-tax rate flattening, and multiple tax credits. Per V4.1, a No vote on a multi-subject bill proves nothing about which provision she opposed, so it cannot establish any rung of "How should government balance what it collects in taxes against what it spends on public services?"
